integrity: A direct standard-library checker exhaustively recomputes square-zero compositions and counts in five finite odd-field cases; the general result is supported by a separate algebraic proof.
scientific_limitations: Only square-zero derivations of triangular matrix algebras over fields of characteristic not two; only reduced geometric components. Characteristic-two contrast is a boundary witness, not a new count. Possible unlocated earlier Borel sandwich classification and no independent priority audit.
title: Cut-support rigidity and exact counts for square-zero derivations of triangular matrix algebras
